exposure: post-placental intrauterine contraceptive device (IUCD) insertion during caesarean section
cohort: 156 pregnant women willing for post placental intrauterine contraceptive device insertion during caesarean section at Qazi Hussain Ahmad Medical Complex, Nowshera, excluding those with postpartum hemorrhage, chorioamnionitis, structurally malformed uterus, and fibroid uterus.
finding: Post-placental insertion of Copper T 380A IUCD during caesarean section had a gross cumulative expulsion rate of 5.7%, removal rate of 7.6%, failure rate of 1.28%, and continuation rate of 85.2% at 6 months follow-up.
